description:
2-Story 3 Bedroom, 3 Bathroom Home with Solar Panels!!!

In this price range, it is common to feel like you have to choose between space and functionality or a home that already feels ready to live in. This one brings both together in a way that makes sense the moment you walk in. Located at 5303 Western Swing Ct, this two story home offers over 2,000 square feet with a layout that feels open where you want it and defined where it matters.

The main level is built for everyday living with spacious living and dining areas that connect naturally into the kitchen. The island creates a central gathering point while still leaving plenty of room to move, cook, and entertain. With appliances already in place including a refrigerator, electric stove, and dishwasher, the kitchen is set up to be functional from day one. The tile flooring throughout the main areas adds durability and keeps maintenance simple. Solar panels are already installed, helping improve energy efficiency and giving you an added long term advantage on utility costs.

Upstairs, all bedrooms are positioned for privacy, including a generously sized primary suite with its own bathroom setup. The additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, work from home space, or anything else you need. With three full bathrooms, the layout supports both daily routines and hosting without feeling crowded.

Out back, the yard gives you space to spread out, whether that means relaxing under the covered patio or making use of the existing above ground pool setup. It is a setup that is easy to enjoy without turning into a constant weekend project. See it in person and decide how it compares to what else is available.
